title: CISCO Networking
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: CISCO Networking - Certificate of Achievement - CE1083
outcomes: Demonstrate an understanding of routing fundamentals,subnets and IP addressing schemes.
Explain the command and steps required to configurerouter host tables, and interfaces within the RIP, EIGRPand OSPF protocols.
Demonstrate an understanding of switching concepts andLAN design to include the use of Virtual LANs with LANtrunking configured by the Spanning Tree Protocol.
Define and demonstrate the concepts of Cisco’simplementation of ISDN networking including WAN linkoptions.

notes: The page header prints 'CISCO Networking - Certificate of Achievement - CE1083' twice and then 'CISCO Networking - Certificate of Achievement - CE920'. Only one requirements section follows. A reviewer should confirm which control number applies to this award.
The catalog prints codes with a hyphen (CIS-26A, CIS-26B, CIS-26C). These were matched to the closed-list codes CIS 26A, CIS 26B and CIS 26C, so they are not marked as catalog additions.
